\textit{Family.} The first four estimates are ratios of native-service totals, retaining four sessions per root. Interaction is the root-geometric mean of $(L_P/W_P)/(L_{L4}/W_{L4})$ and exceeds one when packing attenuates the LOCAL effect. Each interval is a 99\% marginal member of the prespecified five-comparison Bonferroni family, conditional on the four observed sessions.
